transcript: The week after I graduated from university I set off alone for southern Europe A cheap airline ticket and worn-out backpack were all I had The old quarter of Barcelona was a maze of bare stone walls and narrow lanes My footsteps echoed against the walls At every turn, a small craft shop or a folk music bar appeared Down at the harbour, a dozen fishing boats were lined up In the market, the scent of fresh bread and the aroma of rich spices drifted in the air And stirred my appetite, I took a train south And stayed at an inn in a whitewashed village The owners were a generous elderly couple who served me dinner The furniture was old but well kept On the last morning, I leaned on the balcony and looked out at the sea The wind blew gently, this time of leisure was exactly what I had been seeking on the journey The trip taught me something The world is far more friendly And far broader Than I had ever imagined

segments.text: The week after I graduated from university
I set off alone for southern Europe
A cheap airline ticket and worn-out backpack were all I had
The old quarter of Barcelona was a maze of bare stone walls and narrow lanes
My footsteps echoed against the walls
At every turn, a small craft shop or a folk music bar appeared
Down at the harbour, a dozen fishing boats were lined up
In the market, the scent of fresh bread and the aroma of rich spices drifted in the air
And stirred my appetite, I took a train south
And stayed at an inn in a whitewashed village
The owners were a generous elderly couple who served me dinner
The furniture was old but well kept
On the last morning, I leaned on the balcony and looked out at the sea
The wind blew gently, this time of leisure was exactly what I had been seeking on the journey
The world is far more friendly
